question:
(i) What are electric field lines?
(ii) Explain why two electric field lines never intersect each other.

options.A:
(i) Field lines are real paths followed by electric charges
(ii) They can intersect when the field is strong
options.B:
(i) Field lines are imaginary curves whose tangent gives field direction
(ii) They cannot intersect because that would imply two field directions at one point
options.C:
(i) Field lines are circular paths of electrons
(ii) They do not intersect because electric charge is conserved
options.D:
(i) Field lines are equipotential surfaces
(ii) They cannot intersect because the potential is zero
